card.summary: No free tier published on the pricing page; the smallest plan is SPARK XS at USD 4 a month.

free_tier.stated: No free tier published on the pricing page; the smallest plan is SPARK XS at USD 4 a month.

retention.stated: Not stated on the pricing page read; a monthly plan implies the disk persists while the plan is paid.

egress.terms: 1 TB of bandwidth included on SPARK XS; the price of traffic beyond it is not published on the pricing page.

record.interface_detail: A Firecracker microVM with a deploy flow and an order page; 'API Access' is listed only on the SPARK M plan and above, so SPARK XS has no published API.
record.tooling: SSH to a Linux microVM. The site is a small operator's storefront: no SDK, no CLI and no documented API at the USD 4 tier.
record.chaining: The cheapest published monthly microVM with a dedicated 1 vCPU: USD 4 a month for 1 vCPU, 512 MB and 10 GB NVMe with 1 TB of transfer. Use it where a real always-on box is wanted and 512 MB is enough, which rules out anything with a JVM, a database and an agent runtime on the same box.

limits.value: 1 TB of bandwidth a month on SPARK XS

record.limits_note: The shape is the first wall: 512 MB of DDR5 RAM and 10 GB of Gen5 NVMe, with no published resize or add-on disk path on the pricing page. Volume discount is 5% from USD 300 a month.
record.binding_note: 512 MB of RAM is the shape ceiling under USD 5, and the next plan (SPARK S, 2 vCPU / 2 GB) is USD 7; the 1 TB traffic cap is the metered wall behind it.

identity_cost.detail: A monthly plan implies a payment method at checkout; no card, hold or debit statement was read on the pricing page. Unverified.

record.reliability_note: waitlist only: the order page says "All Slots Currently Occupied" and offers no order button
record.confidence_note: The plan name, price, shape and traffic allowance are quoted from the pricing page. automated retrieval served a stored snapshot of that page captured at 01:49 UTC rather than a live fetch, so the page was read but not re-fetched. SSH, the payment method and the overage rate are not on the page.
